# How Do You Escape?
This guide explains how to breach containment when you are assigned the role of SCP-457.
[textlink="General information about the Burning Man" link="Scp457About"]
[textlink="More about methods for complex personnel to contain the Burning Man" link="Scp457Containment"]
## Primary Method
This method involves waiting until your flame dies out completely.
[textlink="More about abilities" link="Scp457Abilities"]
Every 12 seconds, your flame dies down. As it fades, you lose size until you eventually become small enough to enter the ventilation system and escape through it. [bold]In this state, you can:[/bold] - Pass through any airlock - Attack personnel and quickly hide - Move freely throughout the complex
Keep in mind that you are very weak in this state, and even one person with a fire extinguisher can defeat you!
[textlink="More about states" link="Scp457States"]
## Alternative Method
Personnel may overdo it and give you far more fuel than necessary. This makes you too large and powerful.
You can then destroy walls and other structures by colliding with them, and your health and damage increase.
Keep in mind that you will no longer fit through doorways and will have to break through walls, slowing you down.
## How Do You Resist Capture?
Once you leave your containment chamber, personnel will begin trying to capture you. Your task is to resist them.
Use the "Ignite tile" ability to control an area and force personnel to wait for the flames to die out. Use the "Ignite" ability to set a crowd of people on fire and create chaos that you can use to escape or continue your attack. While small, you can hide in the ventilation system. Use this to escape from people quickly.
